name: Imanol Rodriguez
summary: 'Himan': an elite flyweight athlete with power and a strong striking-plus-grappling mix; 7-0 and a TUF semifinalist who went to a coin-flip decision with eventual winner Joseph Morales.

how_they_fight.Defense: Can be hit when he over-commits to pressure.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Uses takedowns and scrambles as a second weapon.
how_they_fight.Striking: Horsepower is the calling card: aggressive, powerful for 125, can be wild. Got caught by sharp shots from Kevin Borjas in his UFC debut but regrouped and finished him in round two.

patterns: Owner's notes, UFC 332: fast and mean; refused to let it be a point-fighting match and overwhelmed Coria.
keys_to_beat: Counter his pressure with accurate shots

sources.author: E. Spencer Kyte
